svg.text: Varka's warm-up test, JDK 25, 512-bit vectors, on a laptop; each block has its own axis
100 fresh JVMs per arm, each running one earlier kernel, then the allocating one: JVMs that released
one JVM per arm through 400 compositions: kernels released at the deadline, of its warm-ups
a second set of runs over the same compositions (534 warm-ups), the warm-up off, two JVMs per arm
